project_info.theme: Luxury beauty macro series with deep chocolate gloss and a dark chocolate prop
project_info.creative_direction: Editorial multi-frame close-up focused on makeup texture, eyes, lips, and tactile confectionery detail
project_info.color_palette: chocolate brown, warm beige, soft rose, natural skin, espresso, and filmic black

main_subject.type: clearly adult woman matching the approved face reference
main_subject.detail: adult high-fashion model with soft brown hair, smoky brown-black eye makeup, elongated winged liner, natural full brows, rosy blush, and visible skin texture
main_subject.makeup: deep chocolate-brown glossy lips with controlled specular highlights
main_subject.interaction: holding a small piece of dark chocolate just beside the closed lips or resting it near the lower face; no biting

composition_elements.framing: 1:1 editorial multi-frame consistency with beauty close-up and extreme macro variations of lips and eyes
composition_elements.series_layout: four coordinated frames with consistent face, makeup, lighting, and chocolate prop
composition_elements.environment: minimal studio background in soft warm neutral tones

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft diffused beauty light from the front with minimal fill and subtle gloss rim at approximately 4300K
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: even skin, controlled lip reflections, realistic chocolate texture, shallow creamy bokeh, and restrained luxury mood

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame cinema camera with 100mm macro prime at f/2.8, luxury beauty film still
technical_specs.finish: soft filmic highlight rolloff, subtle analog grain, natural skin, razor-sharp eyes, and clean macro detail

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a luxury beauty editorial macro series of a clearly adult woman using the approved face reference, preserving facial features, face shape, eye makeup, and identity. Show soft brown hair framing the face, smoky brown-black eye makeup with elongated winged liner, natural full brows, rosy blush, visible skin texture, and deep chocolate-brown glossy lips with controlled wet-looking highlights. Include four coordinated beauty close-up and extreme macro variations focused on lips and eyes, with a small piece of dark chocolate held just beside the closed lips or near the lower face, never bitten. Use a minimal warm-neutral studio, full-frame cinema camera with a 100mm macro prime at f/2.8, soft approximately 4300K diffused beauty light, minimal fill, creamy bokeh, soft filmic highlight rolloff, and subtle analog grain. Keep the editorial intimate in a refined beauty sense, not sexual, and preserve consistent face and makeup across the series.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, sensual lip-biting, open-mouth chocolate bite, ambiguous age, celebrity likeness, watermark, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted lips, extra fingers, melted chocolate, broken series continuity
